newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African average T-Bill rate 14.93 pct.
newsitem.headline: South African average T-Bill rate 14.93 pct.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills fell to 14.93 percent at the latest weekly tender after rising to 14.98 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 2.212 billion rand. The average price was 96.280 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.11 percent from 15.01 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 710 million rand. The average price was 92.465 rand percent.
